shared_span_convention.coordinates: Original source, one-based lines and Unicode-code-point columns, end-exclusive.

preconditions: Successfully parse an actual Python raise statement.
Its exception is a call to the simple name NotImplementedError.
The call has exactly one positional argument and no keyword arguments; the argument is a literal AST Constant whose value is str.
Apply existing recognized abstract/typing-stub exemptions to the owning function before reporting.
normalization_in_order: Trim ASCII whitespace and collapse each internal run of ASCII whitespace to one U+0020 space. ASCII whitespace means U+0009 through U+000D and U+0020 only.
Apply Unicode casefold to the resulting string.
Remove at most one final ASCII period U+002E, if present.
Compare the entire result exactly with the closed set. Perform no additional trimming, punctuation removal, substring matching, stemming, similarity matching, or intent inference.
normalization_boundaries: Uppercase and ASCII whitespace variants, including leading and trailing ASCII whitespace, are accepted when they normalize to a member.
An attached single final period is accepted; exclamation marks, two final periods, extra words, and Unicode whitespace do not receive special normalization.
The value unfinished . is not accepted: removing its final period leaves a trailing space and therefore no exact set member.
call_shape_boundaries: Bare NotImplementedError, a zero-argument call, empty strings, additional positional arguments, keyword arguments, variables, bytes, f-strings, qualified callees, aliases, and other exception classes do not satisfy this branch.
A raise cause does not change the exception-call criterion: raise NotImplementedError("unfinished") from exc qualifies outside exemptions.
Literal decoding and parser-supported adjacent literal concatenation may supply a Constant str value. They do not introduce message-payload source highlighting.

accepted_criteria.lookup: Compare the base identifier with the actual owning signature; keep attached * or ** separately as explicit kind evidence.
accepted_criteria.kind_conflict: When the base name exists and its explicitly written star kind conflicts, report on the exact source identifier. State the documented and actual kinds in diagnostic content.
accepted_criteria.absent_name: When the base identifier is absent, report that missing/stale name on its identifier only, including when documentation writes *missing or **missing. Do not invent a kind conflict against a nonexistent parameter.
accepted_criteria.unstarred_name: Omitted stars do not alone assert an explicit conflicting kind.
accepted_criteria.mapping: Exclude stars, the :param introducer, optional type expression, whitespace, delimiters, and description. Select the declaration's identifier occurrence, preserving Unicode spelling; never use a global text match.
accepted_criteria.ownership: Compare only with the field's owning function or method signature. The supplied return-type issue remains outside this decision.

test_requirements: Add new development fixtures that pin all four accepted exact coordinates and source slices; retain every historical frozen annotation unchanged.

For C004, independently pin Requests negative, Add logic here positive, unfinished positive, and issue-specific planned work negative. Test every one of the six accepted messages and exact normalization boundaries: ASCII whitespace, casefold, one attached final period, two periods, exclamation, Unicode whitespace, extra words, and no substring matching.

For C004, test strict call shape with zero, one, and multiple positional arguments; keyword arguments; nonliteral and f-string values; bytes; aliases; qualified callees; other exception types; and a raise cause. Ordinary strings, assignments, commented-out code, and prose mentioning raises must not satisfy parsed-raise eligibility.

Keep protected-stub tests non-vacuous: put an accepted positive message in each recognized exempt shape and pair it with a nonexempt owning function using the same message. Pin neighboring and nested ownership so exemptions cannot leak. Existing test fixtures may change to accepted positive messages without expanding the contract vocabulary.

For C004 markers, pin TODO, FIXME, and XXX source slices, indentation, punctuation, trailing inline placement, token-boundary near misses, and detailed content that remains outside existing context-free eligibility. Preserve existing whole raise/call spans, including multiline literals; do not assert payload-only highlights.

For G038 and V015, pin the supplied spans, one-word and analytic phrases, article inclusion, verb exclusion, original multiline whitespace, Unicode prefixes, indentation, and punctuation exclusion. Pair eligible unbounded claims with supported attached-target or explicit-scope controls; keep recognition evidence and highlight extents separate.

For C009, test both star-kind mismatch directions, matching kinds, unstarred variadic names, absent unstarred and starred names, optional types, repeated names in types/descriptions, Unicode identifiers and prefixes, inline and multiline docstrings, and adjacent/nested owners. Assert message semantics separately from exact identifier-only source slices.

unresolved_risks_and_limits: Finite lexical cues can still occur in deliberate rejection and miss real unfinished code. The contract reports accepted placeholder wording, not proven author intent.
The strict simple-name and literal-call criterion is syntactic; runtime shadowing is unresolved, and aliases or richer static shapes are deliberately unsupported.

Name-only C009 highlights leave kind markers outside the selected range. Clear diagnostic text is required; a later usability study could justify a separately published amendment, but no such evidence is available here.

Parser support and exact Unicode, escape, concatenation, and multiline source mapping were not inspected. Any implementation claims require focused tests; C004 payload mapping is not part of this contract.
Exact comparative/superlative vocabulary, context windows, unsupported field grammar, new decorated comment syntax, and duplicate suppression are not redesigned by this decision.
No reserved holdout was opened, no old label was repaired, and no effectiveness result follows from selecting these development criteria.
